Prayer wraps with talisman gauzes and steel prayer beads for striking and dealing damage. The ability to pray while striking is integral to cultivators of the Luminous Mind and Divine Communion.

A push dagger. For quick stabbing. Often dipped in toxins and so on.

All kerises are dipped in venoms and blessed. The resonant consciousnesses of kerises make them particularly susceptible to Spirit-Generation. Souls live within ancient old kerises. The strongest ones are the ones not made by factories.

The everyman's tool. For chopping, cutting, clearing weeds, opening coconuts, jamming machines, and so on. Also good for killing people.

The Buddhocommunists are a strand of Masangwanist-Wairinists who fight for the Liberation of all Sentient Beings across the entire Cosmos. Much of them have been expelled from Hingsajagra, but they have left a few of their iconic ginunting—with blades made of captured supernovae—to inspire the Masangwanists to aspire for the Heavens.

The Cudgel is the most common and cheapest weapon: the majority of bodyguards wield cudgels.

Erlang Shen was an Archeprimval Deity who stood toe to toe and had an intense rivalry with the Great Sage Equal To Heaven, Wukong. His Mountain- Maneuver Axe was a highlight of his inventory and repertoire.

SHE SAW THE UNIVERSAL FORM WITH UNLIMITED MOUTHS AND EYES AND IT WAS WONDROUS. A GARLANDED BODY, EVER EXPANDING, UNLIMITED. A THOUSAND SUNS RISING INTO THE SKY CAN NEVER COMPARE TO THE EFFULGENCE OF THE SUPREME OVERSOUL. AND THE OVERSOUL SAID: “I AM TIME AND I AM DEATH. I AM THE DESTROYER OF WORLDS. ALL OF REALITY IS THIS: TREMENDOUS AUTOPHAGOUS VIOLENCE.”
